home.title: Room to breathe.
home.lede: Where your money goes — and how much you can still save.

noData.m: Add your income and commitments to see a score.

low.m: Only {pct}% of income is left. Try cutting one commitment.

good.m: {pct}% left over — you are on a good track.

high.m: {pct}% of income is committed. Suggested: under 60%.

unsettled.m: {n} items are not marked paid this month.

allSettled.m: All {n} commitments this month are settled.

solid.m: Score {score}/100 — your finances are under control.

breakdown.title: Commitment breakdown
breakdown.empty: No commitments to break down yet.

upcoming.title: Upcoming payments
upcoming.empty: No dated payments left to settle.

commit.title: Monthly commitments
commit.emptyBody: Add your first item, import a backup, or start from the sample figures.
commit.seeded: Sample figures loaded — adjust them to suit you
commit.noMatchBody: Try another search or clear the filters.
commit.helper: Tap the circle to mark as paid. Every change is saved on this device right away.

form.name: Item name
form.errAmount: Please enter a valid amount (0 or more).
form.errDay: Due day must be between 1 and 31.
form.errDup: An item with the same name, category and amount already exists.
form.errSave: Could not save: {msg}. Please try again.

sched.title: Payment timeline
sched.desc: All monthly commitments in date order — see what is coming up and what still has time.
sched.emptyBody: Add commitments with a due day to see them here.
sched.clamped: Adjusted to the last day of the month
sched.otherMonth: Payment status is only shown for the current month.

routine.title: Commute routine
routine.desc: Estimated daily fuel cost based on your trip to class.
routine.targetDesc: Set your base figures so your balance has a direction.
routine.recDesc: Every commitment repeats monthly on the same day.
routine.note: Assumption note. Fuel cost is not counted as a monthly commitment yet. Enter the fuel price and your routine to see an estimate; add it to the list if you want it to reduce your balance automatically.

data.title: History & data
data.desc: Every commitment record with its latest changes. Backups and storage are managed in Settings.

set.title: Settings centre
set.themeNote: Your theme is saved on this device and never affects your financial data.
set.langNote: Your language is saved on this device. Financial values never change.
set.storageWarn: Browser storage is not a permanent backup. Clearing browser data ("Clear site data") will erase it. Export a backup file now and then.
set.cacheNote: Clearing the cache only removes the app files stored for offline use. Your financial records are not touched.
set.snapNote: Saved on this device before every major change (import, reset) and once a day.
set.snapEmpty: No restore points yet. They are created automatically.
set.syncNote: Cloud sync is tied to this browser only. To move to another device, export then import.
set.privacyText: Your financial records live in this browser and, when Firebase is active, sync to your own anonymous cloud account. No records are stored in the GitHub repository.

imp.title: Import preview
imp.mergePlan: Merge will: add {added} new, update {updated}, restore {restored}; skip {dups} duplicates and {same} identical.
imp.replacePlan: Replace all will remove {current} current records and use {total} records from the file.
imp.replaceBody: {current} current records will be replaced by {total} records from the file. A copy of your current data is saved first under "Restore points".
imp.done: Import complete: {added} added, {updated} updated, {dups} duplicates skipped

snap.restoreBody: Your current data will be replaced by this copy. The current data is saved first as a restore point, so this can be undone.

reset.title: Reset the application?
reset.body:
Will be deleted: all your commitments, income, target and routine settings.

Will not be deleted: your theme and language, plus restore points — the current data is saved as a restore point first so it can be recovered.

cache.title: Clear the cache?
cache.body: App files stored for offline use will be removed and the app will reload. Your financial records are not deleted.

toast.syncFail: Sync not successful — your data is safe on this device
toast.ptrFail: Cannot reach the cloud — showing on-device data
toast.conflict: {n} changes from another device were newer. This device's version is kept under "Restore points".

banner.noStorage: Device storage is unavailable. Changes will NOT be saved ({msg}). Close Private/Incognito mode or use another browser.
banner.legacyCorrupt: Your old data could not be read. It was not deleted — the original copy is in Settings for download.
banner.noJs: Ruang Bajet needs JavaScript to display and save your data.

err.badStructure: The file structure is not recognised.
err.notBackup: This file is not a Ruang Bajet backup.
err.noSchema: The file has no schema version.
err.newerSchema: This backup is from a newer version (schema {v}). Update the app first.
err.noRecords: The file has no record list.
err.badRecords: {n} records in the file are invalid — import cancelled so no bad data gets in.
err.dupIds: The file contains duplicate record IDs.
err.noIdb: IndexedDB is not supported by this browser
err.dbBlocked: The database is blocked by another tab
